newsitem.title: INDIA: FORECAST-India Larsen net seen 11 pct up.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST-India Larsen net seen 11 pct up.

text.p: Indian engineering & Construction firm Larsen & Toubro Ltd is likely to see its net profit climb 11 percent to 4.33 billion rupees in the year ended March 31, 1997, analysts said on Thursday.
Larsen said its board of directors is due to meet at 3:00 p.m. (0930 GMT) on Thursday and financial results for 1996/97 are expected to be announced by around 5:30 p.m. (1200 GMT).
In a snap poll ahead of the firm's results, analysts from leading securities houses forecast an average net profit of 4,326.50 million rupees, up from 3,886.90 million in the previous year.
Net profit forecasts ranged from a low of 4,186 million rupees to 4,530 million.
The Financial Express newspaper said the engineering firm's net was likely to be lower at around 4.1 billion rupees.
Net sales were likely to be around 53 billion rupees against 42.48 billion in 1995/96, the newspaper said.
Larsen shares were trading 0.25 rupees higher at 204 on the Bombay Stock Exchange. The firm's shares have fallen nearly four percent this week.
